Pachinko Fever — Innate Technique (6th level)

Once you reach 6th level, after activating Idle Death Gamble and getting a Jackpot, you gain advantage when making your Event roll or Multiplier roll within your next domain.

jjk5e.automationNotes: After a Jackpot: advantage on the next domain's Event or Multiplier roll (roll 2d20kh).
